journeys.name: Add New Apprenticeship to a Cohort
journeys.description: Allows a provider to add a new apprentice to a cohort from entry through specification, including creating a new cohort or using an existing one.

journeys.name: Manually Add Apprentice to Cohort
journeys.description: Provider manually enters details for a new apprentice when adding to a cohort.

journeys.name: Edit an Existing Apprenticeship
journeys.description: User edits an apprenticeship, selects options, and confirms or cancels changes.

journeys.name: Handle Data Lock on an Apprenticeship
journeys.description: Provider resolves a data lock issue by reviewing and confirming a restart.

journeys.name: Add Details for Draft Apprentice to a Cohort
journeys.description: Provider enters new draft apprentice details and handles required options or prior learning.

journeys.name: Manage Cohort Details and Actions
journeys.description: Provider accesses a cohort details hub, from where they can review, acknowledge, or delete cohorts, and manage apprentices within.

journeys.name: Handle Overlapping Training Dates When Changing Employer
journeys.description: Provider encounters an overlap alert when changing an apprentice's employer and resolves it.

journeys.name: Acknowledge Declined or Invalid Apprentice Changes
journeys.description: Provider acknowledges declined or invalid change records for an apprentice and returns to the apprentice details.

journeys.name: Review and Respond to Apprenticeship Updates
journeys.description: Provider reviews proposed updates to an apprenticeship and then returns to apprentice details.

journeys.name: View and Undo Recent Updates to an Apprenticeship
journeys.description: Provider views recent updates to an apprenticeship and can return to the apprentice detail or view full history.
